notes.title: Update - New levels and characters!
notes.notes:
Hello guys!

We're releasing an update that contains some improvements:
[list]
[*] Character selection
[*] 4 new levels
[*] 5 new characters inspired by streamers who supported us
[*] More references
[*] More Achievements
[*] More deaths
[*] More blood
[*] More tension
[*] More laughter
[/list]
Thanks to all who supported us!
I wish you a good game and I hope you have fun!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34996685/6400060e301781658160070c0ab858f9d96ec3a2.gif[/img]

notes.title: New Content
notes.notes:
Hello folks, we received lots of positive feedback from people who bought and played the game, also from youtubers and people who watched your videos. We've decided to release new content to give you more entertainment.

At first we will launch new characters, option to select the character you want to play, new maps, more achievements and correction of some bugs.

Many people have asked us to play multiplayer, but this change is too big and we are thinking of leaving it for There's a Butcher Around 2.

Please leave us suggestions as we intend to launch these improvements in a few days.

Thank you to everyone who is supporting us and giving us feedback.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34996685/663458d3828bc3729cb86cc89454afc2377f9edb.gif[/img]
